en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a panoramic view of a large monastery complex built on top of a steep rocky cliff, overlooking a valley with distant mountains. The monastery has stone walls and small domed roofs. In the foreground and below are rugged rock formations and sparse vegetation. French text at the top identifies the monastery, and the right side mentions the region of Thessaly. A website watermark appears at the bottom right.
